EXTRACT.

Relating to HODANN.

Extracted from P.F.R.3319 (STAHL) Vol.4. No. 286a.
Author of original S.I.S. Place and date of origin 20.1.36.
Extract made by M.J.E.B. on (date) 22.1.36.
Copies sent to

M.I. (Captain Liddell) CX/12171, dated 20.1.36.

The SWITZ Case.

2. The photographs of DOZENBURG, TILTIN, Soloman KANTOR, GOBARD and Max HODANN were shown to Mr. and Mrs. SWITZ, as also the photographs of Adolph RABINOWICZ, HAMMERMANN, David and Mrs. ROSENTHAL, and Leon JOSEPHSON of the Mink Case. They were, however, unable to identify any of them.

As requested by you in your PFR.4186/D38 of 9.1.36, I return herewith the photograph of Soloman KANTOR.

(sd) S.M.

for V.V.
